title: Find Valid Email Addresses
description:
A signup import has messy emails. Report every customer whose `email` is a **plausibly valid** address: one or more letters/digits/`._%+-` before an `@`, one or more letters/digits/`.-` after it, and a final dot followed by 2+ letters (the TLD).

Use `REGEXP_LIKE(email, ...)`. Name the columns `id` and `email`. Return rows in any order.
hint: Anchors `^` and `$` pin the whole string. `+` means 'one or more', `{2,}` means 'at least two'. Escape the literal dot as `\.`.
outputExplanation: bob@example.com and alice@mail.co match the pattern; 'bob@' has no domain, 'nope.example' has no @, and '@x.com' has nothing before the @.
